c: THE DEFAULT. A short task, a rule, then the reasoning at a controlled measure. The unused width to the right is reading margin.
ADVERSARIAL — seven steps. The template does not change; the page is taller.
A prompt that carries substantial information, beside the reasoning. Chosen by the author, never inferred.
ADVERSARIAL — a one-line prompt in a split. The author asked for a split, so it is a split.
COLLECTION · repeat. Every item visible, one after another — repeat(single.flow), and each child literally IS a single.flow, measures included.
ADVERSARIAL — six examples, one of a single step and one of three. Same repeated child; the count is nowhere in the geometry.
Two cases whose relationship matters, then why they agree.
ADVERSARIAL — cases of very unequal length. Their heights are not consulted.
The cases across, then ONE visual.interpretation belonging to both. A balanced figure resolves the SIDE subdesign.
ADVERSARIAL — a wide figure resolves the DOWN subdesign. Same composition, the other approved subdesign.
A figure and the reading of it, standing alone. A portrait figure resolves SIDE.
ADVERSARIAL — a wide figure resolves DOWN. The suffix is the figure's geometry, never the length of the prose beside it.
COLLECTION · tabs — EXAMPLE TABS. The same three examples, one at a time. An authored choice about a Worked Examples page, not a response to height.
ADVERSARIAL — an eight-step example beside a one-step one. Length is not a reason to add a tab, and not a reason to remove one.
PRESENTATION · tabs — REPRESENTATION TABS. One idea, two authored views: solve it, then read the same fact off the curve. This is what visualCheck was.
ADVERSARIAL — a line of mathematics wider than its measure, inside a tab. It scrolls locally; the tab bar is untouched.
SCROLL · page. Nothing bounded, nothing hidden, nothing compressed. Several screens tall, and that is the desired outcome.
SCROLL · persistent pane — THE ONLY PLACE LOCAL-Y IS LEGITIMATE. The stimulus stays while the worklist moves against it. The narrow state gives the bound up and returns to page scroll.
SCROLL · local-x. A table of values and an un-breakable expansion. Each scrolls inside its own region; the page never scrolls sideways.
THE ASSEMBLY — topic tabs → an approved composition inside each topic → representation tabs inside one topic. Substitution repeats; Solving for x flows; Symmetry is solved and then seen.
